title: Seedance2.5で縦アニメを作るときはテキストのみでも高画質になりやすいので、縦画像アニメではなくテキストtoビデオで生成する
content:
Seedance2.5で縦アニメを作るときはテキストのみでも高画質になりやすいので、縦画像アニメではなくテキストtoビデオで生成する  
Moderate DOF around f/4を指定して被写界深度を中程度にし、背景の地形が読めるようにする  
0.6秒の滑らかなラックフォーカスを1回だけ入れ、花に0.5秒フォーカス→0.6秒で目に移す（no huntingも明記して迷いを防ぐ）  
モーションブラーはnatural 180-degree-shutter motion blurを指定して自然なブラーにする  
視差はperspective/foreshortening/diagonal staging/depth layers/coherent parallaxを明記し、3D CGI化しないようにwithout turning her into 3D CGIを入れる  
奥行きレイヤーは最低3層（公園なら4層推奨）を指定し、前景（葉や手すり）は家など遠景より強いパララックスで速く動かすよう指示する

en.content:
When creating vertical animations with Seedance 2.5, text-only prompts tend to produce higher quality, so generate them as text-to-video rather than vertical image animation.  
Specify moderate DOF around f/4 to keep the depth of field medium, so the background terrain remains readable.  
Add only one smooth 0.6-second rack focus: focus on the flower for 0.5 seconds, then shift to the eyes over 0.6 seconds (also specify no hunting to prevent hesitation).  
For motion blur, specify natural 180-degree-shutter motion blur to achieve a natural blur.  
For parallax, explicitly mention perspective/foreshortening/diagonal staging/depth layers/coherent parallax, and include without turning her into 3D CGI so she does not become 3D CGI.  
For depth layers, specify at least three layers (four recommended for a park), and instruct that foreground elements such as leaves and railings should move faster with stronger parallax than distant elements like houses.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Excerpt from the prompt below.
【Focus】
Moderate DOF around f/4 keeps geography legible. Exactly one smooth 0.6s rack focus from flower to eyes; no hunting. Focus flower 0.5s, rack to eyes in 0.6s.
【Blur (Motion Blur)】
natural 180-degree-shutter motion blur
【Depth / Parallax】
Use perspective, foreshortening, weight, diagonal staging, depth layers, and coherent parallax without turning her into 3D CGI. At least three depth layers, preferably four in park; near objects move faster. Foreground leaves/railings show stronger parallax than houses.

es.content:
Al crear animaciones verticales con Seedance2.5, incluso solo con texto es fácil obtener alta calidad, así que conviene generar con text-to-video en lugar de una animación de imagen vertical.  
Especifica Moderate DOF around f/4 para mantener una profundidad de campo media y que la geografía del fondo siga siendo legible.  
Añade un único rack focus suave de 0.6 s: enfoca la flor durante 0.5 s y luego pasa a los ojos en 0.6 s (indica también no hunting para evitar vacilaciones).  
Para el motion blur, especifica natural 180-degree-shutter motion blur para lograr un desenfoque natural.  
En la parallax, deja claro perspective/foreshortening/diagonal staging/depth layers/coherent parallax, e incluye without turning her into 3D CGI para evitar que se convierta en CGI 3D.  
Para las capas de profundidad, especifica al menos 3 capas (4 recomendadas en un parque) e indica que el primer plano (hojas o barandillas) se mueva más rápido con una parallax más fuerte que el fondo lejano, como las casas.

fr.content:
Lorsqu’on crée une animation verticale avec Seedance2.5, même un simple texte a tendance à produire une image de haute qualité ; il faut donc générer en text-to-video plutôt qu’en animation d’image verticale.  
Spécifier Moderate DOF around f/4 pour obtenir une profondeur de champ moyenne et rendre la géographie de l’arrière-plan lisible.  
Ajouter un seul rack focus fluide de 0,6 s : focus sur la fleur pendant 0,5 s → transition vers les yeux en 0,6 s (indiquer aussi no hunting pour éviter toute hésitation).  
Pour le motion blur, spécifier natural 180-degree-shutter motion blur afin d’obtenir un flou naturel.  
Pour la parallaxe, préciser perspective/foreshortening/diagonal staging/depth layers/coherent parallax, et ajouter without turning her into 3D CGI pour éviter une conversion en 3D CGI.  
Pour les couches de profondeur, spécifier au minimum 3 couches (4 recommandées dans un parc) et demander aux éléments du premier plan (feuilles, rambardes) de se déplacer plus vite avec une parallaxe plus forte que les éléments lointains comme les maisons.

【Profondeur et parallaxe (parallaxe)】

ko.content:
Seedance2.5로 세로 애니메이션을 만들 때는 텍스트만으로도 고화질이 나오기 쉬우므로, 세로 이미지 애니메이션이 아니라 text-to-video로 생성한다  
Moderate DOF around f/4를 지정해 피사계 심도를 중간 정도로 두고, 배경의 지형이 읽히도록 한다  
0.6초의 부드러운 rack focus를 한 번만 넣고, 꽃에 0.5초 포커스한 뒤 0.6초에 눈으로 옮긴다(no hunting도 명시해 망설임을 방지)  
모션 블러는 natural 180-degree-shutter motion blur를 지정해 자연스러운 블러로 만든다  
시차는 perspective/foreshortening/diagonal staging/depth layers/coherent parallax를 명시하고, 3D CGI처럼 보이지 않도록 without turning her into 3D CGI를 넣는다  
깊이 레이어는 최소 3층(공원이라면 4층 권장)으로 지정하고, 전경(잎이나 난간)은 집 같은 원경보다 더 강한 parallax로 더 빠르게 움직이도록 지시한다

Ao criar animações verticais com o Seedance2.5, como até mesmo texto puro tende a gerar alta qualidade, gere em text-to-video em vez de animação de imagem vertical  
Especifique Moderate DOF around f/4 para deixar a profundidade de campo em um nível intermediário e permitir que a topografia do fundo continue legível  
Insira apenas uma vez um rack focus suave de 0,6 segundo, com foco de 0,5 segundo nas flores → mudando para os olhos em 0,6 segundo (mencione também no hunting para evitar hesitação)  
Para motion blur, especifique natural 180-degree-shutter motion blur para obter um desfoque natural  
Para a parallax, deixe explícito perspective/foreshortening/diagonal staging/depth layers/coherent parallax, e inclua without turning her into 3D CGI para evitar que ela seja convertida em 3D CGI  
Para as camadas de profundidade, especifique no mínimo 3 camadas (4 camadas recomendadas em um parque) e instrua que o foreground (folhas ou corrimãos) se mova mais rápido, com parallax mais forte, do que o background, como casas

zh.content:
在使用 Seedance2.5 制作竖屏动画时，即使只用文本也很容易获得高画质，所以不要生成竖图动画，而要用 text-to-video 生成  
指定 Moderate DOF around f/4，将景深设为中等，让背景地形也能看得清楚  
只加入一次 0.6 秒的平滑 rack focus：先对花朵聚焦 0.5 秒，再在 0.6 秒内移到眼睛上（并明确写上 no hunting 以防止焦点游移）  
运动模糊指定为 natural 180-degree-shutter motion blur，使模糊效果更自然  
视差部分明确写入 perspective/foreshortening/diagonal staging/depth layers/coherent parallax，并加入 without turning her into 3D CGI，避免变成 3D CGI 风格  
深度层至少指定 3 层（如果是公园场景建议 4 层），并指示前景（如树叶、栏杆）要比房屋等远景具有更强的 parallax、移动更快
